discription: A bright, slightly gritty lead sound using a pulse wave with subtle pulse width modulation and a low-pass filter.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pulseWidth=0.5, pwModFreq=0.5, filterCutoff=8000, rq=0.5; var sig, env, pwMod, filteredSig; var envCurve = Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4); env = EnvGen.ar(envCurve, gate: gate, doneAction: 2); pwMod = SinOsc.kr(pwModFreq) * 0.1 + pulseWidth; sig = Pulse.ar(freq, pwMod.clip(0.05, 0.95)); filteredSig = LPF.ar(sig, filterCutoff, rq); Out.ar(out, (filteredSig * amp * env) ! 2); }
